sections.text_helper: Section 61.6.10 "RTC write protection register (RTC_WPR)" in chapter 61 (Real-time clock (RTC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3039.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x24
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 KEY[7:0]: Write protection key
This byte is written by software.
Reading this byte always returns 0x00.
Refer to RTC register write protection for a description of how to unlock RTC register write
protection.
